secrets.name: The Bed Under the Bed
secrets.text: Under the unmade bed there was a trapdoor, and under the trapdoor a room with one more bed in it, made so neatly the corners are sharp enough to cut. The lamp is on. The sheets are warm.

meta.label: The Dormitory
meta.blurb: Beds, made, as far down the hall as you can see, a lamp on at every one, and nobody in any of them. They are all waiting for somebody to be tired.
